papers.title: Direct evidence of melting and decomposition of TiC particles in laser powder bed fusion processed 316L-TiC composite
papers.first_author_affiliation: Singapore Centre for 3D Printing, School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, 50 Nanyang Avenue, 639798, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Wei Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Singapore Centre for 3D Printing, School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, 50 Nanyang Avenue, 639798, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Sharon Mui Ling Nai
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Manufacturing Division, Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology, 5 Cleantech Loop, Cleantech Two Block B, 636732, Singapore

papers.venue: Journal of Material Science and Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究LPBF制备316L-TiC复合材料中TiC颗粒的熔化和分解现象，未涉及生物医用植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽、疲劳性能或骨整合等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on the metallurgical behavior of TiC particles in a steel matrix composite during LPBF, with no mention of biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF过程中TiC颗粒的熔化和分解机制
summary_zh.method: 通过微观结构表征和相分析研究TiC在316L基体中的行为
summary_zh.result: 发现了TiC颗粒熔化和分解的直接证据
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证，包括微观结构观察和相分析

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the melting and decomposition behavior of TiC particles during laser powder bed fusion of 316L-TiC composites.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization and phase analysis were performed on LPBF-processed samples.
summary_en.result: Direct evidence of TiC melting and decomposition was observed, with formation of new phases.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through SEM, EDS, and XRD analysis.

papers.title: Effect of post-processing and variation of the building angle of Ti-6Al-4 V disks obtained by selective laser melting: A comparison of physical, chemical and mechanical properties to machined disks
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Dental Materials and Prosthodontics, Ribeirão Preto Dental School, University of São Paulo (USP), Ribeirão Preto, SP, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Andréa Cândido dos Reis
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Dental Materials and Prosthodontics, Ribeirão Preto Dental School, University of São Paulo (USP), Ribeirão Preto, SP, Brazil

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V圆盘的构建角度和后处理对物理、化学和力学性能的影响，与机加工圆盘进行了对比，为生物医学植入物的制造工艺优化提供了参考。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not directly address stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration of porous implant structures; it focuses on the effect of building angle and post-processing on bulk mechanical properties of solid disks.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估后处理和构建角度对SLM Ti-6Al-4V圆盘性能的影响，并与机加工圆盘对比。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同构建角度和表面处理的圆盘，进行物理、化学和力学性能测试。
summary_zh.result: 构建角度和后处理显著影响表面粗糙度、硬度和微观结构，力学性能与机加工圆盘有差异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度及表面形貌测试验证性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effects of post-processing and building angle on the physical, chemical, and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V disks fabricated by selective laser melting, compared to machined disks.
summary_en.method: Disks were manufactured at different building angles and subjected to various post-processing treatments, then characterized by surface roughness, microstructural analysis, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Building angle and post-processing significantly influence surface roughness, hardness, and microstructure, leading to different mechanical properties compared to machined disks.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing (hardness, tensile) and surface morphology analysis.

papers.title: Contemporary Isolated Bearing Exchange for the Management of Hip Instability Following Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, New York

corresponding_authors.name: Gwo‐Chin Lee
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, New York

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文为全髋关节置换术后不稳定管理的临床研究，未涉及生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or perform any finite element or mechanical testing; it focuses on clinical management of hip instability.

summary_zh.motivation: 管理全髋关节置换术后不稳定
summary_zh.method: 采用隔离轴承交换治疗
summary_zh.result: 临床结果改善，脱位率降低

summary_en.motivation: To manage hip instability following primary total hip arthroplasty through isolated bearing exchange.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study of patients undergoing isolated bearing exchange for instability.
summary_en.result: The procedure improved stability and reduced dislocation rates.
